opportunities.name: Purge health-AD orbit
opportunities.objective: Test purge health-ad orbit against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Purge attacks three times per second with AD scaling; Bloodmail and Titanic favor health-driven physical attack pressure while Cleaver supports repeated physical packets. Disdain shields with AD and source-health terms, and Visage supports that shield during the orbit required to expose separate shotgun legs.
opportunities.requiredState: Max-rank W and enough room to rotate around the victim.
opportunities.failure: Peel blocks leg access and W can choose an unwanted nearest target.
opportunities.test: Measure six-leg exposure, shield size and Purge item damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Purge's fixed firing rate is not increased by ordinary attack-speed purchases.

opportunities.name: Purge toggle Spellblade weave
opportunities.objective: Test purge toggle spellblade weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: At rank five Purge toggles freely; Trinity tests an ordinary attack between W firing intervals after Q/E, while Blade supplies physical on-hit pressure subject to Purge effectiveness. Eclipse supports separate-hit shielding and Cleaver handles physical shot/leg damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Practice toggle timing so a full ordinary attack lands without losing W uptime.
opportunities.failure: Poor timing removes more shots than Spellblade adds.
opportunities.test: Compare uninterrupted W with repeated three-shot-plus-normal-attack cycles.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not assume every Purge bullet gets full on-hit damage or a fresh Spellblade charge.

ruledOut.reason: Purge's fixed firing rate is not increased by ordinary attack-speed purchases.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Purge health-AD orbit
builds.summary: Test purge health-ad orbit against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test purge health-ad orbit against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Purge attacks three times per second with AD scaling; Bloodmail and Titanic favor health-driven physical attack pressure while Cleaver supports repeated physical packets. Disdain shields with AD and source-health terms, and Visage supports that shield during the orbit required to expose separate shotgun legs.
testPlan: Required state: Max-rank W and enough room to rotate around the victim.
Measure six-leg exposure, shield size and Purge item damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Peel blocks leg access and W can choose an unwanted nearest target.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Purge's fixed firing rate is not increased by ordinary attack-speed purchases.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Titanic Hydra, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds.

Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. He Attacks them [3] times a second dealing [12 + (0.2 / 0.235 / 0.27 / 0.305 / 0.34) × AD] physical damage per shot. Urgot can move while firing and has [40]% Slow resistance, but loses [125] Move Speed.

At max rank, this Ability lasts indefinitely and can be Toggled on and off.

Urgot charges forward, gaining [55 / 75 / 95 / 115 / 135 + (1.35 / 1.35 / 1.35 / 1.35 / 1.35) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.135 / 0.135 / 0.135 / 0.135 / 0.135) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Shield for [4] seconds. The first champion hit is Stunned for [1.5] seconds and thrown behind Urgot. All enemies Urgot collides with take [90 / 120 / 150 / 180 / 210 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing [100 / 225 / 350 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing for [4] seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to [75]%.

If the impaled victim falls below [25]% Health, Urgot can Recast this Ability, Suppressing the victim and dragging them to himself. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for [1.5] seconds.

Urgot has a cannon on each of his 6 legs. Attacks and {{Spell_UrgotW_Name}} will fire the leg cannon that is facing his target for [(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.4, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.11999999731779099, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.11999999731779099, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.11999999731779099, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.11999999731779099, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 15, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.11999999731779099, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × AD] plus [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.02, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.009999999776482582, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.009999999776482582, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.009999999776482582, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.009999999776482582, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] max Health physical damage. This effect has a [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -10.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -2.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown per leg.
